position_cost_interpretation: Source-only positions do not assert a verified ledger prefix. Six declared positions were preanchored; the extra midpoint-derived case was not. Indexed wall time includes full source and index/sample SHA plus every-anchor/EOF verification; unindexed prefix scan excludes hashing. Do not divide their whole times as an equal-scope speedup. Cache state was uncontrolled.
restart_interpretation: Actual process exit9 after 20 selected records, 16 manually saved early and 4 pending. Fresh process verifies and reuses 16, recomputes 48. Source global ordinal is not a claimed verified full prefix. This is a 64-record actual ledger recovery, not 166897-record verified-ledger recovery. The early manual boundary is a declared fault test, not the default commit-count cost. Complete restart cost is phases.true_verified_subset_process_restart.seconds, including process startup/crash/recover/proof/preservation. Child timers are nested breakdowns sampled before its digest/receipt, not additive or substitutes for complete cost.
privacy: All raw records, selected keys/ordinals, next-frame bytes, model contents and per-query hashes remain ignored local evidence. Public quantities are aggregate byte/cost/position observations.
